dedupe_keys.name: globaldata intelligence platform power plant oil and gas asset and construction project databases

description: GlobalData sells a subscription intelligence platform with over 290 proprietary datasets built from primary research, maintained by about 2,000 in-house analysts across many industries. For infrastructure, three industry offerings matter. Coverage: power, with profiles of active, planned and under construction power plants across generation technologies, transmission and distribution line and substation projects in over 70 countries, renewable energy auction tracking, an energy storage project database, tenders and contracts and equipment markets; oil and gas, with upstream, midstream and downstream assets including oil and gas fields, wells and exploration blocks, LNG terminals, gas processing plants, storage terminals, pipelines, refineries, petrochemical plants and tankers, plus new-build and expansion project tracking and supply and demand balances; construction, tracking projects over 25 million US dollars from announcement to completion by sector, stage, scope and key dates, a project contacts database, and market sizing and forecasts said to cover over 97 percent of the global construction market. Format and access: one digital subscription with search, dashboards, configurable tools and downloads, plus an AI research assistant; demos on request. Licence: commercial subscription terms, not read. Caveats: counts on the pages read did not render (placeholders such as '1 k'), so dataset sizes were not confirmed; fields and history were not checked; prices are not published. Simulation uses: asset and project pipelines for power, oil and gas and construction in capacity planning, planned infrastructure scenarios and supply chain studies. Related records: BloombergNEF (data-bloombergnef-energy-transition-research-and-data) and IJGlobal (data-ijglobal-green-street-infrastructure-transactions).
